correctness.rationale: Reconstructed edge-distinguished triangle indicator and pair-collision Q_k. Every cross-arrival covariance is zero except a collision on exactly the two distinct labels used by the latest triangle vertex k; that collision is incompatible with the triangle and contributes -1/(j-1)(k-1)^3. Summing i<j<k and ordered labels gives the exact stated coefficient, including n=2 boundary and arbitrary m. Pair-collision indicators are pairwise uncorrelated, giving Var(P). Independently enumerated all attachment states for (n,m)=(2,2),(3,2),(4,2),(5,2),(3,3),(4,3) and confirmed exact rational covariances. Limit follows convergent zeta difference; correlation uses the externally proved Var(T)=Theta(log n), not self-derived.
residual_risks: No arbitrary attachment rule or simple-graph conditional law; no leading Var(T) constant established.

evidence: The multigraph model and general fixed subgraph count approximation cover more motifs but not this exact two/three cycle overlap sum.
